about: Audited registry of every external data source, dataset and third-party component used by AeroSuite 26. Each conclusion rests on a page or licence file that was downloaded on the retrieval date; "url" is the page and "quote" is copied from it. This is a compliance aid, not legal advice: a lawyer can check each line against its URL. The app reads this file: in commercial mode (config.json, "commercial": true) a source is contacted only if its class is "commercial-ok" and its entry does not set "usedInCommercial": false, or the operator supplied the key/URL it needs, or the operator listed its id under "accept".

classes.commercial-ok: The licence or terms explicitly allow commercial use; the listed obligations apply.
classes.commercial-with-key: Commercial use is allowed only with a paid plan/key, the operator's own infrastructure, or a source the operator has licensed and configured.
classes.unclear: No explicit grant covering this use was found; excluded from commercial mode unless the operator accepts it in config.json.
classes.not-allowed: The terms exclude this use without the provider's consent; never used in commercial mode unless the operator holds a licence and lists the id under "accept".
